purpose: D05 bounded scenario evidence; D07 dated source checks; D08 facts-only provenance. Research evidence, not a production overlay.
verification_semantics: source_reported means retrieved primary publisher reports the fact; not onsite, phone or operational verification. checked_at is retrieval/review date, never source_updated_at. Unknown/ambiguous/conflicting properties stay unknown.

source_authority.city_tourism: VisitAstana publishes the city tourism program; city government independently describes the program at https://www.gov.kz/org/astana/press/news/details/989755?lang=ru (actual page read). This does not make VisitAstana the legal venue owner.
source_authority.operator_self_published: Branded branch page with own contacts and directory linkage; no corporate title inferred.
source_authority.mall_host_self_published: MEGA own-domain directory reports its tenants; legal tenancy/ownership not independently adjudicated.

summary.remaining_dataset: not reviewed; existing unknowns remain unknown
